summary: An owner calculating the second year at {apartment} must separate the first guideline increase from other charges.
realLife: For covered two-year leases, New York City's 2023 order applied a second percentage to the lawful first-year amount but excluded increases other than the first-year guideline from that calculation.
gates: The case record identifies the first-year lawful rent, guideline amount and other adjustments.
inGame: needs: first-year lawful rent, guideline amount and other adjustments.

turns.what: The second-year base can be reconstructed.
The parties need a breakdown before checking the new amount.
turns.pulledBy: The ledger rolls all increases together
